paite: Tang a pan Mosi ahong paisuk pah louh mite'n atheih un, mite Aaron kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, akiang ah, "Kisa in, ka ma ua pai ding, pathiante hon bawlsak in. Hiai Mosi, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhepa lah, bang chita ahia, ka thei ngal kei ua," achi uhi.
heading: Dangka-eng Bawngnou Lim / (Diu 9.6-29)
english: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”

paite: Aaron in akiang uah, "Na zite uh bil a om, na tapate uh bil a om, na tanute uh bil a om, dangka-eng bilbahte tolkhia unla, ka kiang ah hon tawi un,” achi hi.
english: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”

paite: Mi tengteng in abil ua dangka-eng bilbahte atolkhia ua, Aaron kiang ah ahon tawi uhi.
english: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.

paite: Ama'n akhut ua pan huaite ala a, sunthoh bawngnou lim abawl a, huai bang in dangka-eng bawngnou lim in asung hi. Huai khit in amau, "Israel aw, Aigupta gam a pan nang hon pikhia na pathian hiai ahi,” akichi uhi.
english: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”

paite: Aaron in huai amuhtak in, ama uah maitam abawl a, Aaron in thupuan anei a, "Zingchiang TOUPA a dia ankuangluina ahi," achi hi.
english: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to Yahweh.”

paite: Azing in beltak in athou ua, halmang thillat alan ua, lemna thillat atawi uhi. Mite ne ding leh dawn ding in atu ua, kimawl ding in adingh uhi.
english: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Kumsuk in, na mi Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiakte, akihihsiat ziak un.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!

paite: Amau ka lampi hilh a pan apial pah man hial uhi. Bawngnou lim sun akibawl ua, huai abia ua, amai ah thillatte alan ua, 'Israel aw, hiai na pathian, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhetu ahi,' achi uh," achi hi.
english: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai mite ka muta a, ngai in, migenhakte ahi uhi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in atung uah ka thangpaihna akuangzak a, amaute ka kattum theihna ding in hon subuai kei in. Huchi in nam thupi in ka hon bawl ding," achi hi.
english: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA a Pathian angen a, "TOUPA, thilhihtheihna thupi leh ban thahat a Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiaksa, na mite tung ah bangziak a na thangpaihna kuangzak ding ahia?
english: Moses begged Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?

paite: Bang ding in ahia Aiguptate'n thu gen a, 'Hihse dia amau pikhia ahita ve, tangte a amaute that ding leh leitung maikaih a pan amaute kangtum ding in?' Na thangpaihna thupi lakik inla, na mite tung a hiai thil hoih lou na ngaihtuah kikhelsak in.
english: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.

paite: Akiang ua, 'Van a aksite bang in na suante ka pungsak dia, na suante kiang a thu ka gensa, hiai gam tengteng ka hon pe ding, huchi in tangtawn in na luah ding uh,' chi a, nangmah ngei a na kichiamna, na sikhate, Abraham, Isak leh Jakob theigige in," achi hi.
english: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’”

paite: Huchi in amite tung a thil hoih lou hih dia angaihtuah TOUPA'N akikhelsakta hi.
english: So Yahweh turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.

paite: Mosi akihei a, tang a kipan apaisuk hi. Akhut ah theihpihna suangpek nihte a-om a, suangpekte alangnih tuak a gelh ahi a, khat lam leh langkhat lam a gelh ahi uhi.
english: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.

paite: Suangpekte Pathian thilhih ahi a, agelhte leng Pathian gelh ahi, suangpekte tung a kigelhte.
english: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

paite: Joshua in mite kikou husa azak in Mosi kiang ah, "Giahphual ah kidouna husa a-om," achi hi.
english: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”

paite: Ama'n, "Tungnun kituh a kikoute aw ahi kei a, nuaisiah a om ziak a kapte aw leng ahi kei. Lasate husa ahi zaw ka zak," achi hi.
english: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, giahphual kiang ahong tuntak in, bawngnou leh lam amuta hi. Huchi in Mosi hehna asou a, akhut a pan suangpekte apai a, tang nuai ah akeksakta hi.
english: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.

paite: Abawngnou bawl uh ala a, mei ah akhul a, agawinen a, tui tung ah atheh a, Israel suante adawnsak hi.
english: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.

paite: Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Hiai mite'n bang ahia na kiang a ahih uh, atung ua hichi tel a khelhna thupi na tunsak?" achi hi.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”

paite: Aaron in, "Mite'n thil sia azondan uh na thei hi, ka toupa' hehna kuang kei hen.
english: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.

paite: Ka ma ua pai ding, pathiante hon bawlsak in. Hiai Mosi, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhetoupa lah, bang suakta ahia ka thei ngal kei ua, ka kiang a achih ziak un.
english: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

paite: Ke'n akiang uah, dangka-eng nei peuh in hon tolkhia un ka chi hi. Huchi in amau kei ahon pia ua; ke'n mei sung ah ka khia a, hiai bawngnou lim ahong pawtkhia," achi hi.
english: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”

paite: Aaron in a-utut ua om dia mite ataizak uh phal in, melmate ma ah zahlak in a-omsak, chih Mosi in amu hi.
english: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),

paite: Giahphual kongpi ah Mosi adingh a, "TOUPA lam a pang kuakua ahia? Ka kiang ah hong pai hen," achi hi. Akiang ah Levi ta tengteng akikhawmkhawmta uhi.
english: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on Yahweh’s side, come to me!” All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Israel TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi: Michih in apang ah anamsau kuah henla, giahphual tuansuak in kongpi khat a pan kongpi dang ah lut in pawt henla, michih in asanggampa, michih in alawmpa, michih in a-invengte that hen," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”

paite: Levi tapate'n Mosi thu dungzui in ahihta ua; huchi in huai ni in mite lak ah mi sangthum asi uhi.
english: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.

paite: Mosi in, "Michih in atapa, michih in a-unaupa douta na hih ziak un, ahon vualzawl theihna ding in tuni in TOUPA a ding in kihihsiangthou un," achi hi.
english: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to Yahweh, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”

paite: Azing in hichi ahong hi a, Mosi in mite kiang ah, "Khelhna khawktak in na khialta uhi. Tu in TOUPA kiang ah ka hohtou dia; na khelhna uh a ding in lemna ka bawl thei maithei hi," achi hi.
english: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to Yahweh. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”

paite: TOUPA kiang ah Mosi akik nawn a, "Aw, hiai mite'n khelhna thupitak ahih ua, dangka-eng pathiante akibawl uhi.
english: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.

paite: Ahi a lah, tu in, akhelhna uh ngaidam in; Na ngaihdam kei dingleh, na gelhsa na laibu a pan kei hon thaimang in, ka hon ngen ahi," achi hi.
english: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Kuapeuh ka tung a khial, ka laibu a pan ka thaimang ding.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in kuan inla, na kiang a ka genna mun ah mite pi in. Ngai in, na ma ah ka Angel apai ding. Akoi abang hitaleh gawt dia ka veh ni in akhelhna uh ziak in amaute ka gawt ding," achi hi.
english: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”

paite: Huchi in Aaron in abawl bawngnou mai a thil alat ziak in TOUPA'N mite hipi in agawtta hi.
english: Yahweh struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.
